name: Chaturanga
goal: Trap the enemy Raja so it cannot escape.
howToWin: Checkmate the enemy Raja, stalemate it, or capture every other enemy piece.
ruleVariant: Shatranj-style: no queen or bishop, no castling, no pawn double step, stalemate is a win.
about: Chaturanga is the Indian ancestor of chess, played over 1,400 years ago.

name: Dots and Boxes
tagline: Draw a line, close a box
goal: Close more boxes than your rival.
howToWin: Take turns drawing one line. Draw the fourth side of a box to own it and go again. The most boxes wins.
ruleVariant: Classic Dots and Boxes: one line per turn, close a box and go again, most boxes wins. Boards from 3x3 up to 10x10 boxes.
about: Dots and Boxes is a pencil-and-paper game played in many countries for over a century.

name: Huli Meke
tagline: The tiger and goat game of Karnataka
goal: Goats trap all the tigers. Tigers capture enough goats.
howToWin: As the goats, leave every tiger with no move. As the tigers, jump over enough goats to reach the capture target.
ruleVariant: Standard: 3 tigers vs 15 goats, tigers win with 5 captures, goats place first then move one step, 80 moves without a capture is a draw. Mini: 1 tiger vs 5 lambs, 2 captures. 11 board layouts.
about: Huli Meke, also called Aadu Huli, is a traditional hunt game played in Karnataka for generations.

name: Pallanguzhi
goal: Collect more seeds in your pile than your rival.
howToWin: Sow seeds round the board and capture seeds. The biggest pile at the end wins.
ruleVariant: Simple classic: 7 pits each, 5 seeds in every pit, one game (no refill rounds).
about: Pallanguzhi is a traditional seed-sowing game played across South India, with many local versions.

name: Ten Frame Garden
goal: Fill the frame so both parts make 10.
howToWin: Tap empty cells to plant seeds until the frame is full. Fill five frames to grow a garden of flowers.
ruleVariant: A ten-frame is 2 rows of 5. Dots has no numbers. Fill to 10 and Two parts make 10. Bonds to 20 uses two frames. No timer, no losing.
about: Ten frames are a classroom tool that shows how numbers fit together. Pip the sprout helps you see pairs that make 10 and 20.
